# Getting help

- **How do I...?** Start with the [documentation site](https://garytang32.github.io/RSI/), the
  [examples](../examples/README.md) and the skill's step-by-step recipe
  ([`SKILL.md`](../.claude/skills/rsi-improve/SKILL.md)).
- **Questions and ideas:** open a [GitHub Discussion](https://github.com/GaryTang32/RSI/discussions) if they are
  enabled, otherwise an issue with the "Feature or method request" template.
- **Bugs:** open an issue with the "Bug report" template, ideally with an offline (`--llm sim`) reproduction.
- **Security problems:** report them privately as described in [`SECURITY.md`](../SECURITY.md), not in a public issue.

This is a volunteer-maintained project; responses may take a few days.
